name: @hamzatrq/openrouter-image-mcp

tools.name: list_image_models
tools.description: List supported image-generation models with their accepted imageConfig keys, allowed aspect ratios, allowed image sizes, and whether they accept image input.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description:
Generate (or edit) image(s) via OpenRouter. Returns saved file paths plus inline image content and metadata.

Each model only accepts specific imageConfig values. Do NOT guess — use these:

- google/gemini-2.5-flash-image:
    aspectRatio: 1:1, 1:4, 1:8, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:1, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 8:1, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9
    imageSize:   0.5K, 1K, 2K, 4K
- google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview:
    aspectRatio: 1:1, 1:4, 1:8, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:1, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 8:1, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9
    imageSize:   0.5K, 1K, 2K, 4K
- google/gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview:
    aspectRatio: 1:1, 1:4, 1:8, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:1, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 8:1, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9
    imageSize:   0.5K, 1K, 2K, 4K
- openai/gpt-5.4-image-2:
    aspectRatio: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9
    imageSize:   1K, 2K
- openai/gpt-5-image: imageConfig not supported.
- openai/gpt-5-image-mini: imageConfig not supported.
- openrouter/auto:
    aspectRatio: (unknown — pass-through)
    imageSize:   (unknown — pass-through)

Use `count` to generate multiple variations in parallel (1-8).
For image-to-image, pass `inputImages` (only on models with supportsImageInput=true).
Call `list_image_models` for a programmatic view of the same data.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired image.

model.description: OpenRouter model ID. Any image-capable slug works; call list_image_models for the curated set. Defaults to google/gemini-2.5-flash-image.

count.description: Number of independent images to generate in parallel (1-8). Each is a separate OpenRouter call. Defaults to 1.

inputImages.description: Reference/source images for image-to-image. Each entry is one of { url } | { path } | { base64, mimeType? }. Only works on models with supportsImageInput=true.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio as "W:H". Accepted values are per-model — see acceptedAspectRatios in list_image_models.

imageSize.description: Output resolution tier. Accepted values are per-model — see acceptedImageSizes in list_image_models.

strength.description: Image-to-image strength in [0.0, 1.0]. Lower values stay closer to the input. Recraft only.

style.description: Artistic style preset name. Recraft V3 only.

rgbColors.description: Palette of RGB colors that should influence the output. Recraft only.

backgroundRgbColor.description: Specific background color in RGB. Recraft only.

textLayout.description: Structured spec for placing text at positions. Recraft V3 only.

fontInputs.description: Custom font specs for text rendering. Sourceful only.

superResolutionReferences.description: Up to 4 reference image URLs that enhance low-quality elements. Sourceful only.

imageConfig.description: Standardized OpenRouter image_config knobs. Server validates each provided key/value against the chosen model.

modalities.description: Override response modalities. Defaults to ['image','text'] for multimodal models, ['image'] for image-only ones.

extra.description: Escape hatch: extra top-level fields merged into the OpenRouter request body. Use `extra.image_config` for image_config keys not yet typed here.

instructions: Generates images via OpenRouter. Catalog source: hardcoded. Tool description embeds per-model accepted imageConfig values. Use them verbatim.
